classification: Ordinary-sized source arithmetic/presentation defect, no browser execution
operation: terrain_skill_rows enumerates six terrain abilities and divides direct-hour sum by6 but effective-hour sum by5. The resulting aggregate tooltip reports6/5 of the actual mean effective hours.
counterexample: For six direct terrain fields of100h each, actual canonical PlayerSkills::effective_skill_hours adds five .20*100 one-pass correlations, yielding200h for each leaf. Mean direct=100 and mean effective=200. Current six-entry sum1200 /5=240; SkillTooltip retains100 direct, computes140 correlated, and accessible_description says240 effective hours. Correct same-six-leaf aggregation would show100 correlated and200 effective. This is static source reasoning, not an executed synthetic fixture or actor state.
actual_recipient: terrain_skill_rows passes the incorrect average to SkillTooltip::aggregate; rank::skill_rank_bar_with_tooltip serializes it into data-skill-tooltip and adds accessible_description into data-strategic-tooltip. The terrain rank average itself divides six and is unaffected by this specific divisor bug.
acceptance: Give the actual six-leaf terrain presentation aggregate one coherent member set/count for direct, effective and rank projections; preserve current one-pass correlations, intuitive zero-direct transfer, six leaf ordering, healthy-vs-injured rank policy and tooltip accessibility. Do not change canonical correlation coefficients or gameplay ranks to make the tooltip agree. No source changes or tests requested during discovery.
